name: Nairobi
local_intro: From city apartments and family homes to busy offices and customer-facing premises, cleaning needs in Nairobi can vary widely from one property to the next. Reste Propre discusses the space, its use and your priorities before preparing a suitable cleaning plan.

local_faq.q: Can I request apartment cleaning in Nairobi?
local_faq.a: Yes. You can enquire about apartment cleaning, including the rooms and tasks you want covered. Share your estate or neighbourhood and the size of the space when requesting a quote.

local_faq.q: Do you handle office cleaning in Nairobi?
local_faq.a: Office cleaning is one of the services Reste Propre is set up to discuss. Tell us about your workplace, preferred schedule and cleaning requirements so availability can be confirmed.

local_note: Tell us which Nairobi neighbourhood your property is in and whether it is a home, office or commercial space.

name: Machakos
local_intro: Homes, apartments, offices and growing commercial premises around Machakos can each call for a different cleaning routine. Reste Propre starts by understanding the type of property, the areas that need attention and the timing that works for you before discussing a tailored quote.

local_faq.q: Can I ask for a one-off deep clean in Machakos?
local_faq.a: You can enquire about a one-off deep clean and explain which rooms or areas need attention. The team can confirm the scope and availability before a booking is agreed.

local_faq.q: Do you clean homes as well as business premises in Machakos?
local_faq.a: Reste Propre is designed for both residential and commercial cleaning enquiries. Include the property type and your requirements so the right service can be discussed.

local_note: Include your specific area around Machakos and the type of property when you contact the team.
